| global: advisory, no traceback | `…unreadable_envelope_is_a_diagnostic_and_never_a_traceback` | green (pin) |
| (f) M5 second `Run:` | `…names_the_bundle_key_and_the_three_sources` | red: grep exits 1 |
| (f) M5 third `Run:` | `…no_longer_calls_the_file_the_one_place_to_look` | red: grep exits 1 |
| guard on the shared `sed` range | `…still_findable_by_the_run_legs_own_sed` | green |
